accepted.evidence: CDIAL 13271 sarpa explicitly gives Assamese xāp and Bengali sāp snake. Hajong hap shares the corresponding p-final stem. Together these establish the working Hajong h correspondence; the joint analysis and all source records are preserved in hajong-h-matrix.json. This supports the initial sound correspondence without settling intra-Indo-Aryan transmission or the extra morphology of the dry comparanda.
